requirement: Typer service gateway CLI with environment variable type coercion, whitespace-safe list parsing, and strict boundary validation for workers (>=1) and timeout (>0.0).
skeleton: Typer app with serve command and parse_endpoints helper function.

rationale.teaches: A Typer serve command whose options bind to environment variables, a list parser that strips whitespace and drops empties, workers at least 1, timeout strictly positive, and metrics on by default.
rationale.why: Environment-driven configuration fails at deploy time, not in a unit test with clean arguments. The fixture sets each variable to a boundary value and runs the command through CliRunner.

candidates.why_wrong: The endpoint list is split without stripping, so a value with spaces yields entries with leading blanks and an empty trailing entry.
workers of 0 or a negative number is accepted, so the gateway starts with no workers.
A timeout of exactly 0.0 is accepted, so every request expires immediately.
Metrics default to off, so a deployment that does not set the flag exposes no Prometheus endpoint.
The timeout option loses its envvar binding, so GATEWAY_TIMEOUT is silently ignored.
